  "recovered_c": "#include <stdint.h>\n#include <stddef.h>\n\nuint64_t fn_09(const uint8_t *in, size_t len, uint64_t arg, uint8_t *out, size_t out_cap) {\n  uint64_t hash = 0xcbf29ce484222325;\n  if (len != 0) {\n    const uint8_t *ptr = in;\n    while (ptr < in + len) {\n      hash = (hash ^ *ptr) * 0x100000001b5;\n      ptr++;\n    }\n  }\n  return hash;\n}"
